import unittest

from brain.core import BrainError
from brain.intelligence import validate_payload


class PendingProviderCheck(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pending_is_valid_only_without_a_terminal_conclusion(self):
        repository = "P00NSMASHER/abvmschoolstarworld"
        sha = "15886d848294450265313ac3d3f439fa18702afc"
        root = "https://github.com/" + repository
        check = {"name": "verify", "head_sha": sha, "status": "pending", "conclusion": None,
                 "url": root + "/actions/runs/41740686942/job/126281121501"}
        payload = {"repository": repository, "head_sha": sha, "default_branch": "main",
                   "source_ref": root + "/commit/" + sha, "checks": [check], "open_issues": 0}
        validate_payload("repository", payload, "2026-11-03T23:41:36Z")
        check["conclusion"] = "success"
        with self.assertRaises(BrainError):
            validate_payload("repository", payload, "2026-11-03T23:41:36Z")
